info.title: Nova Bank Institution Integration API
info.description:
**Nova Online Bank** — REST API for banks, payment institutions, card acquirers, and fintech partners.

Protocol version **Nova Sync 101.1** · Visa Card Authorization 101.1 · SWIFT / IBAN rails · Settlement middleware.

## Authentication
| Scheme | Header | Use |
|--------|--------|-----|
| Member JWT | `Authorization: Bearer <token>` | End-user / member operations |
| Admin | `X-Admin-Key` | Ledger import, settlement run, funding seed |
| Merchant | `X-Merchant-Key` or `X-Nova-Merchant-Key` | Card pre-auth & authorize (merchant API) |
| Webhook | `X-Nova-Signature` | Inbound provider webhooks |
| Institution | `X-Institution-Api-Key` + `X-Client-Cert-Fingerprint` | mTLS institution API (wires, balances, inbound credit, LP sender) |

## Required headers (member flows)
- `X-Nova-Protocol: 101.1` — Nova Sync routing (online m0 / offline m1)
- `Idempotency-Key` — required on all `POST` mutations marked idempotent

## Integration entry points
1. **Discovery** — `GET /global/status`, `GET /global/integrations`, `GET /international/integrations`
2. **Popular rail** — `POST /bank/rail/send` (account / IBAN+BIC SEPA or SWIFT / crypto) and `GET /bank/rail/receive`. Dispatches to `POST /fiat/send` and `POST /crypto/withdraw`. Not AI Builder.
3. **Send fiat** — `POST /fiat/send` (Nova Bank API: ledger or SEPA/SWIFT). Canonical member fiat send. `POST /external/transfer` and `POST /transfers/by-party` remain.
4. **Party resolve** — `GET /accounts/resolve` (account # / IBAN) · `GET /external/resolve/{iban}` (thin IBAN wrapper)
5. **Send by party** — `POST /transfers/by-party` (internal account # or external IBAN+BIC — never email)
6. **Inbound credit** — `POST /institutional/inbound/credit` (institution) · `POST /inbound/credit` (admin) · `POST /bank/rail/inbound` · `POST /ledger/import/admin/all-to-account`
7. **International fiat send** — `POST /international/send` (IBAN + BIC → SEPA/SWIFT via `/fiat/send`). Local Ledger auto-promotes to Production. `POST /international/route` remains discovery-only.
8. **Settlement** — `GET /ledger-bridge/status`, `POST /ledger-bridge/settle`
9. **Cards** — merchant pre-auth under `/cards/merchant/*`
10. **Visa JIT** — `POST /visa/marqeta/jit-funding` (network callback)
11. **LP Sender (non-SWIFT API-to-API)** — `GET /lp-sender/framework` · verify / lock / webhooks / LP redemption. Asset value is recognized by the liquidity-providing bank only while the asset-backed ledger is connected to a regulated FI (`GET /lp-sender/ledger/connection`).

Live docs: `/api/v1/docs` · Spec: `/api/v1/openapi.json`

Auth: `X-Institution-Api-Key` + `X-Client-Cert-Fingerprint` (SHA-256, lowercase hex, no colons).
Ops: `scripts/provision-nsb-pay-institution.py` · see `docs/ops/NSB-PAY-INSTITUTIONAL-CLIENT.md`.

tags.name: LP Sender
tags.description:
Non-SWIFT API-to-API sender API for liquidity-providing banks (operator integration requirements 01–04).
Verify transactions/assets, lock against bank issuance, signed status webhooks, LP redemption & settlement.
Value is **not recognized** unless `GET /lp-sender/ledger/connection` reports `recognizedByLpBank: true`
(Apache Fineract / Hybx Finance or Anaka Bank connected). Recipients are Nova 4-digit accounts or `0x` — never an API key.

tags.name: Treasury
tags.description:
Treasury settlement workflow. M1 fiat authorizes a purchase; Ethereum (USDT ERC-20 or native ETH)
proves the asset. Owner JWT is required for POSTs (`X-Admin-Key` is not enough). Never mint USDT from M1.

First-class Nova Bank API. Member JWT + `Idempotency-Key`.

Choose one destination:
- `toAccountNumber` — 4-digit Nova account (ledger)
- `toAccountId` — wallet UUID (ledger)
- `beneficiaryIban` + `beneficiarySwift` + `beneficiaryName` — bank rail (SEPA/SWIFT).

Implementing this route does not grant SWIFT membership.

Outbound events are HMAC-SHA256 over `{unixSeconds}.{rawBody}`.
Headers: `X-Nova-Signature`, `X-Nova-Timestamp`, `X-Nova-Event`.
Queue lifecycle: queued → delivering → delivered | retry_scheduled → dead_letter.
Retry backoff: 1s, 5s, 25s, 125s, 625s.

Requires `txHash`. Progresses pending_settlement → transaction_submitted →
confirming → confirmed → onchain_balance_verified after receipt, success,
confirmations, and a fresh DFNS balance. M1 fiat is not chain proof.

get.summary: Fresh DFNS on-chain USDT and native ETH
get.description: ETH is also required for Ethereum gas. Balances are not inferred from M1.

get.summary: Reconcile expected vs on-chain vs crypto ledger
Payment orchestrator workflow board and adapter credential readiness

post.summary: Create normalized Nova bank payment (dryRun default)
post.description:
M1 → bank balance verified → compliance → bank API → settlement → bankReference/UETR → reconcile → settled.
Does not invent IBAN, UETR, or bank confirmation. Requires Idempotency-Key and owner JWT.

200.description: Dry-run plan or created draft payment

post.description: Fails closed if the bank does not return bankReference.

400.description: Bank reference missing or gate not cleared
